Author: jakeywunder
Name: Retainer Sorter
Description:
Adds 'Sort Retainers' and 'Deposit Items' buttons to the retainer list at a summoning bell.

+ Rules decide which retainer holds what: materia here, materials there, gear, housing, food...
+ Duplicates always end up together, merged into as few stacks as possible
+ Materials can be ordered by the level they are gathered or crafted at
+ A preview shows every retainer before and after; nothing moves until you press Execute
+ Stop at any moment and resume later
+ Profiles can be exported and shared
+ Deposit: put inventory items with the retainers that already hold them, after a preview

A sort only uses your inventory as carrying space and never touches your own items. Only Deposit moves them, and only the ones you see listed.
Punchline: Sorts and rearranges items across all your retainers by rules you choose.
